- Clarified token safety: session tokens (access_token, refresh_token) should never be printed in chat or logs; one-time email verification codes are safe to paste.
- Updated session token persistence notice to more explicitly warn users that tokens are saved in plaintext in TOOLS.md if persistence is enabled.

- No functional or API flow changes; documentation and consent interactions only.
